shortdesc: Ranked and casual multiplayer, profiles, progression and replays. Compatible with polycup.online.

changelogs.0.2.24: Background-tab recovery rebuilds Cup channels and keeps automatic rounds pending while a racer reconnects.
changelogs.0.3.0: Preset checkbox for native Casual mode and leaderboard uploads, with session-only record saving when disabled. Lobby connection indicators and host kick controls, animated rankings, PB/TR/WR record tabs, and a preset rename button. Cup chat with saved history, username colors, name-click mute controls and slur filtering. Late round starts count toward Cup time. Custom tracks are disabled when bans are enabled. Streamlined lobby controls with editable preset names and automatic rule updates. Customizable Standard and Quickplay presets, preset import/export, fixed rounds per track, optional custom tracks and mid-Cup racer changes. Automatic racer recovery, start respawns with cumulative timing, held inputs and camera choice across rounds, continuous spectator handoffs, pending action feedback, and multiplayer version checks.
changelogs.0.3.1: Track removal with score rollback, spectator freecam and viewer counts, and host-only physics warnings. Unified fixed-height lobby with inline preset editing, embedded chat, simpler player controls and lighter labels. Fixed setup disconnects and duplicate racers, rapid checkpoint-reset DNFs, rematch setup, preset icons and lingering notices. Removed tournament/review exports, separate organizer screens and the spectator dropdown; preset sharing and local autosaves remain.
changelogs.0.3.2: Fixed split-update stutters in longer Cups, missing last-checkpoint splits (including single-checkpoint tracks such as Desert 3), stale TR/WR badges after faster finishes, and chat scrolling when switching lobby tabs. Record badges now slide back under racer cards. Improved finish delivery under high latency and packet backlogs. Removed Cup autosaves, restoration, and player-management arrows from final results.
changelogs.0.3.3:
- **Added**: Draft ready-up with locked picks and a cancellable five-second countdown announced in chat.
- **Added**: Host “Return to lobby” control to reset drafting without recreating the Cup or losing its roster and chat.
- **Added**: Preset overwrite confirmation, undo for deleted presets, and clearer validation messages.
- **Added**: Chat unread markers, new-message counts and a jump to the latest messages.
- **Changed**: More compact player cards with inline status, connection icons beside names, and clear ready/banning highlights.
- **Changed**: Reserved ban/pick slots with gray placeholders, smooth fill animations and polished hover effects.
- **Changed**: Click selected tracks to unpick them; additional choices are disabled when all pick slots are filled.
- **Changed**: Moved draft rules into the topbar Rules button and gave the track browser more space.
- **Changed**: Wider live rankings with less wasted space for longer names, without shrinking the font.
- **Changed**: Slim scrollbars throughout PolyCup, smoother pop-up/menu transitions and clearer spectator-switching feedback.
- **Fixed**: Track thumbnails being cropped or blurred by excessive scaling.
- **Fixed**: Player menus losing their position when scrolling or resizing, with improved focus and scroll preservation during UI updates.
- **Removed**: Redundant draft headings, separate pick-summary screens and the between-round “Up next” pop-up.
changelogs.0.4.0:
- **Added**: Main-menu Cup browser, private lobbies, Discord sign-in with automatic return, friends and invitations.
- **Added**: Ranked matchmaking with accept/decline, fixed drafts, persistent ratings, rank badges, leaderboards and public match history.
- **Added**: Two-minute ranked reconnect grace, explicit abandonment and reliable rating results, including notifications after reopening the game.
- **Added**: Background input comparison with public Possible copied inputs detected flags.
- **Improved**: Cup transitions, draft feedback, personal-best tracking, post-Cup rejoining and consistent social UI.
- **Fixed**: Early keyboard input during mod startup.
- **Fixed**: PolyLauncher Discord sign-in opens the external browser through the launcher bridge; return-code instructions and blocked-browser recovery stay visible.
- **Fixed**: Automatic Discord return now works without a browser opener through a short-lived PKCE handoff. The return-code fallback is always visible.
- **Changed**: Close Cup is red at the bottom-left of the lobby; restored the normal 0.4.0 display.
changelogs.0.4.1:
- **Changed**: Shorter ranked matches on one randomly selected track, with a 30-second opening warmup, 10/7/4/2 points and a 30-point finalist target.
- **Added**: Ranked seasons using main tracks and the latest community-track collection, with archived seasonal leaderboards. Ratings and placement progress carry over.
- **Added**: Online player count beside the PolyCup title.
- **Changed**: Leaderboard uploads are enabled by default for new casual Cups and ranked matches.
- **Improved**: A blurred, darkened lobby with a loading overlay during race connection, clearer Private/Public selectors and streamlined ranked lobby controls.
- **Fixed**: Ranked chat profile verification, garage car thumbnails and garage identities inside Cups.
- **Fixed**: Cup finish times now match the native finish-crossing timer.
- **Fixed**: Single-track standings updates after round two, including reconnects and final rating settlement.
changelogs.0.6.1:
- Current PolyCup client, sharing accounts, ranked matchmaking, casual lobbies, profiles and replays with polycup.online.
- Native PML menus and practice are preserved.
changelogs.0.6.2:
- Finish times in ranked match histories, including your time in the list and every racer's time in individual results.
- Separate page arrows and previous/next-track navigation on track leaderboards.
- Consistent rectangular track controls, square player avatars and a cleaner individual match header.
- The PolyCup boot P is now the site's favicon, with SVG and PNG support.
- Compatibility fallback for older browser engines missing `checkVisibility`, fixing repeated menu and queue-control errors.
- Bounded error reporting, graphics-context failure/restoration diagnostics and active-match frame timing for investigating crashes and slow gameplay.
changelogs.0.6.3:
- Replies in DMs and community chat, plus in-game chat carried into postgame.
- New level-reward profile banners and a top-three track record showcase.
- Cleaner, more consistent profiles, leaderboards and player presentation.
- More reliable match transitions and result delivery, with a 45-second loading timeout.
- In-game patch notes with release history, available from the hub.
changelogs.0.6.4: Season 1 countdown and Mythic achievement badges for long-term ranked progression.
changelogs.0.6.5:
- Season 1: fresh placements and revised ratings that separate skill estimates from visible progression, making isolated losses less punishing without penalizing repeat opponents. DNFs cannot gain rating.
- A community-voted 30-track ranked pool: 15 Fullspeed and 15 Tech tracks, with 20 seconds to finish after the first racer.
- Season 0 remains viewable through season selectors, with permanent rank badges revealed on your next hub visit. XP and existing unlocks carry over.
- Expanded profile statistics, official verified PolyTrack placement comparisons beside ranked times, and smoother chat, connections, retirement/spectating and casual/friendly match transitions.
changelogs.0.6.6:
- Season 1 launch polish: remove the expired Season 0 countdown panel from the hub.
- Restore the Mythic achievement tiers in the release reward catalogue.
- Season reward badges show the player's final seasonal leaderboard position.
- More reliable official PolyTrack placements, including million-entry leaderboards and automatic retries after temporary lookup failures.
- Keep leaderboard row highlights contained on Safari.
changelogs.0.6.7: - Restore ranked multiplayer compatibility across patch releases and prevent cancelled loading attempts from reopening.
changelogs.0.6.8:
- Improve phone keyboard activation in postgame chat with a direct request during a trusted tap.
- Keep chat editable during slow sends and preserve newer drafts when a send completes.

- Faster official PolyTrack placement comparisons with shared caching and a top-10,000 cutoff; ties retain their exact placement.
- Restore loading-screen match chat and recover from temporary chat access failures, with improved mobile composer gestures.
- Stabilize fitted profile titles during refreshes and resizing.
- Improve mobile race transitions and starts: clear stale race overlays and garage editors, release held controls at GO, and preserve native drawing if a PolyCup frame hook fails.
- Show finish times and gaps in friendly 1v1 results so close races can be compared after the finish.
changelogs.0.6.9: - Ranked personal bests now save and submit through the native PolyTrack leaderboard path, with official replay validation and no delay to match results.
changelogs.0.6.10:
- Bigger rewards for genuine ranked upsets, with an underdog payout multiplier up to 2.5x. The favourite's loss formula and existing rating caps stay unchanged.
- Withdrawal wins preserve existing win streaks; verified finished wins still extend them, including against opponents who DNF or leave.
- Wait for a recent clock-sync reply and rendered game frames before race readiness, reducing unfair late starts.
- Recover delayed ranked finishes through the authenticated HTTP path, prioritise current finish uploads, and seal input evidence at the finish crossing.
- Keep the driving-time cutoff fixed while allowing a bounded confirmation phase for delayed finish delivery.
changelogs.0.7.0:
- Flying checkpoint respawns in solo Practice on official, community and imported tracks: tap once for flying recovery, twice for a standing reset.
- Run estimate shows your surviving run time and checkpoint splits against the selected record, with a rear camera and translucent car during recovery.
- Full local replays retain failed attempts and both respawn types; native Watch, save and load are supported.
- Clean practice runs keep normal PolyTrack leaderboard submission. Attempts using a respawn stay local and cannot replace native personal bests.

- Vote between three random ranked tracks after everyone accepts. Each vote is one lottery ticket; account portraits show votes, and split votes reveal the chosen track with an animated highlight and check stamp.
- Live race standings show each racer's checkpoint progress alongside their name.
changelogs.0.7.1:
- Flying and double-tap standing respawns now work in ranked and casual races as well as solo Practice. Use R or your checkpoint-reset binding.
- Clean runs keep native personal bests and official leaderboard uploads; using a respawn disables them for that attempt, and a fresh run restores eligibility.
- Ranked replays preserve the complete elapsed run, failed attempts and both respawn types while retaining older replay support.
- Reset the chase camera after start-line recovery and preserve cockpit view and car visibility after respawns.
changelogs.0.7.2:
- Ranked Practice runs an unrated solo rotation with one attempt per track and keeps matchmaking active. Clean personal bests can submit to the official PolyTrack leaderboards.
- Practice the active ranked pool from the new Ranked tracks tab, grouped into Fullspeed and Tech.
- Show the ranked season countdown above matchmaking.
- The Hall of Fame shows champions and cumulative records across all completed seasons. The boards update when a season closes.
- Held keyboard and touch inputs carry through track changes, and releasing during the countdown clears them before GO.
- Close Garage, Profile and other open menus when a match starts loading and hands off to the race.
changelogs.0.7.3:
- The Hall of Fame has an Overall view and a season selector. The current season updates while you browse.
- Ranked results recover when a late loading response interrupts the match handoff. The ranked controls return when you reopen the hub.
